rule: A source is deleted only after its last runtime reader uses configuration.py.

readers: runtime modules calling tunables.shared, tunables.value, or tunables.container_limits
sources.migration: Not migrated in S2 bootstrap. Migrate by job family through configuration.py, preserve units and fingerprints, regenerate tunables documentation, then delete only after the last reader is gone.

readers: model jobs that call review_cli.load_model_config or review_cli.resolve_model
sources.migration: Not migrated in S2 bootstrap. Move model, reasoning, dollar budgets, repair policy and invocation policy as one model-runtime slice; keep credentials out of TOML; delete the JSON file only after its last reader is migrated.

readers: execution_state.py and Dagster definitions: run/process roots
feed, cache, image and database modules: host-local roots and tool discovery
nvd_feed.py and dagster_workflow.py: secrets and notification endpoints
launch_job.py, review_cli.py and feed schedulers: operational defaults
keep_out_of_toml: Dagster-provided execution identity and child-process environment
sources.migration: Review operational defaults such as schedule state, age ceilings, keep counts, run mode and heartbeat by owning job. Secrets and host-local identity remain environment-owned.
Move only operational policy into the matching job_#### step/task table. Keep protocol constants, schema identities and security invariants in code.
